basis: Two independent page-image transcriptions (data/campbell_glp/evidence/merged_A.json, merged_B.json) agreed against the live text; image adjudication data/campbell_glp/evidence/adjudication/out_J9.json; each change re-checked on 5-10x crops of the page image on 2026-10-08 and confirmed by the coordinator on PDF pp. 89-90. Only high-confidence differences are applied; uncertain ones (34a l.1 underdot, 34a l.5 breathing, 129 l.15 bracket spacing, 129 l.23 underdot, 130b l.13 final raised dot) are left as approved.

corrections.what: π not τ before the bracket; underdots printed under ο of πρό̣ and ρ of τρ̣
iota subscript printed under η of Αἰολῄαν
acute printed with the breathing on ὤς

corrections.old: κεῖσεσθ’ ὐπ’ ἄνδρων οἰ τότ’ ἔπικ . .́ ην
corrections.new: κείσεσθ’ ὐπ’ ἄνδρων οἶ τότ’ ἐπικ . .́ ην
corrections.what: acute on κείσεσθ’; circumflex on οἶ; no accent on ἐπικ
diaeresis printed on ϊ of βραϊδίως

corrections.old: ἄγνοις̣ . . ς̣βιότοις̣ . . ις ὁ τάλαις ἔγω
corrections.new: ἀγνοι̣ς̣ . . ς̣βιότοις . . ις ὀ τάλαις ἔγω
corrections.what: ἀγνοι̣ς̣ has a smooth breathing and no accent, with underdots under ι and ς; no underdot under the final ς of βιότοις; smooth breathing on ὀ
smooth breathing only on ἐοι̣ (no acute)
